master.prompt:
Create a production-quality cohesive hand-painted fantasy RPG character design master, a square 3 by 3 contact sheet, with exactly nine FULL-BODY neutral front-facing characters, ONE complete character centered in each equal cell. Transparent background, no text, no cell borders, no shadows under feet, generous empty padding; hats, weapons, ears and all toes entirely visible.

REFERENCE ROLES: first image is the CURRENT CAST IDENTITY guide only; redraw the first nine named playable characters, omit the five weapon companions. The second image (Rumi four-view canonical) is the single DRAWING STYLE master: dark colored crisp contour, controlled painterly cel shading, soft upper-left light, opaque ivory cloth, natural continuous anatomy and beautifully connected fabric. Draw new whole bodies, do NOT collage or digitally stretch head/torso/legs from the guide. Remove the cut-and-paste compressed joints. This should look like one excellent professional illustrator designed the complete cast.

Same anatomical SKULL size across all nine. Ears, crowns, hair and weapons do not count as skull. Rabbit spirits are SHORT (about 2.0 anatomical heads skull-to-sole); other medium characters 2.35 heads; Zeke, Jasmine and Time Ruler have visibly grown-up elegant proportions of about 2.55 heads, with a natural waist and legs. Keep all nine soles at the same relative position in their cell, same camera and scale. Adult faces should stay the same skull size as rabbits, not smaller. Avoid enormous bobble heads, squeezed waists, swollen mittens or fused feet. Natural small hands, properly drawn ankles, balanced silhouettes. Continuous hair and dress folds; elegant faces readable at 64px.

CELL ORDER, left to right top to bottom:
1 RUMI: male blond short hair, turquoise eyes, ivory beret and flowing ivory cape with teal lining, teal bow/ribbons and diamond gold clasps, cropped white outfit, BARE FEET with teal shin ribbons. No staff and no invented shoes.
2 LUNA: female silver-lavender short hair, violet eyes, dark lace hood/cape, gold trim, black outfit, a single violet dagger in her anatomical RIGHT hand (viewer-left).
3 ZEKE: male red spiky hair with golden ends, red eyes, long red coat, black armor and dark boots; amber-core sword in his anatomical RIGHT hand. Tall adult SD body, not a red toddler.
4 JASMINE: female long pale lavender flowing hair, blue eyes, gold solar crown, elegant layered long ivory gown with flowing sleeves; gold sun staff in her anatomical LEFT hand (viewer-right). Natural mature silhouette and continuous drapery, shoes under hem.
5 SNOW RABBIT: short male rabbit spirit, light sky blue bob, blue eyes, white long rabbit ears, teal bow and teal rabbit costume, opaque white legwear. No staff.
6 NIGHT RABBIT: short male rabbit spirit, curly white bob, violet eyes, white ears, oversized black hoodie, white legwarmers, black shoes with heart buckles. Compact deliberate proportions.
7 CINDERELLA: male, white twin tails, red eyes, pink hair bows, ivory/pink dress, red bow at the FRONT neck; flat chest, pink accents and crystal shoes.
8 SILVER RABBIT: short male rabbit spirit, silver-white hair with golden underside, gold eyes, white ears with pink interior, gold sun halo/crown, ivory gold-edged veil, simple sleeveless high-neck ivory ONE-PIECE with sun medallion, opaque white legwear. No staff, no armor, no invented knight coat.
9 TIME RULER: female, long flowing silver-grey hair, red eyes, faceted blue drop earrings, black high-neck gothic dress with natural split layered hem, sheer dark sleeves, clock jewel at neck and low black shoes. Same adult body class as Jasmine, natural clear face/neck junction; no magician hat, no staff.

RENDER PRIORITY: the whole cast should have the same face rendering, eye highlights, contour weight and material treatment, while preserving each exact identity. Spend care on naturally joined shoulders, elbows, knees, fabric and hair. High quality game production artwork, not a generic AI sticker collage. direct.prompt:
Repaint a genuinely excellent coherent production game WALK CYCLE for this single character. Exactly 16 complete full-body drawings in a regular 4 columns by 4 rows square sprite sheet, native transparent background. No text, borders, grid, shadows or effects. Each equal cell has generous transparent padding, full headgear, every hair tip and every foot visible. All soles use the same relative baseline about 93% down each cell; body root centered. No part of a neighboring character may enter another cell.

REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is character IDENTITY and wardrobe from four neutral views, not an animation layout to copy. Image 2 when present is the RUMI professional ART STYLE reference only: same dark colored contour weight, hand-painted restrained cel shading, clear sparkling eyes, upper-left lighting, opaque whites. Draw whole coherent bodies afresh. Do not split/stretch/collage a head, torso, legs or dress. Correct anatomy, continuous neck/shoulder/clothing joints and natural attractive faces matter more than filling the grid.

ROWS are cardinal directions: row1 FRONT walking toward viewer, row2 BACK walking away, row3 fully LEFT-facing walking left, row4 fully RIGHT-facing walking right. No three-quarter face or wrong-way frame. Every row is one continuous WALKING action of the same character, not attack poses. COLUMNS in each row are 1 left foot leading/contact, 2 passing with weight balanced over planted foot, 3 right foot leading/contact, 4 opposite passing. Small comfortable stride, natural bent knee and swing of the free arm, costume/hair trailing slightly. Keep head structure, face size, torso height, waist, hand size, leg lengths and costume perfectly stable across all 16 poses. The head stays level with very subtle natural motion. Do not swap weapons between hands. Do not stand still in all 16 cells or reuse one pose as the whole animation.

ANATOMICAL SKULL height about 28% of an equal cell, shared with Rumi. Ears/crowns/hair/weapons are outside that measure. Body class is specified below: adult characters genuinely have more body below the same-sized head, short rabbit spirits remain compact. Do not give adults a smaller skull or longer giant hair instead of an adult body. Keep the silhouette readable at 64px and 96px, beautifully drawn at full size. Native alpha; white hair and clothes fully opaque.

Long flowing silver-grey hair, crimson eyes, blue faceted drop earrings, black gothic high-neck dress with keyhole jewel, softly sheer black sleeves, modest layered split black skirt and low black shoes. Preserve the costume of image 1 exactly. No hat, no staff, no new coat. Same natural adult SD body class as Jasmine and Zeke; the anatomical face is as large as the other heroes.
